title: Nasty ModMate – Lychee 50ml Shortfill
description:
Nasty ModMate Lychee is a fragrant and well-balanced flavor that combines the sourness and sweetness of a genuine lychee to create the ideal lychee vape.
Lychee by Nasty Juice comes in 50ml bottles with 10ml space to add in your nicotine shot, with 70% VG you can use this liquid in any sub-ohm device.
ModMate by Nasty is a specially formulated Free base solution that’s fine-tuned for optimised performance with all leading Mod devices.
Bottle Size:
60ml
Nicotine Strength:
0mg
VG/PG
70% / 30%
